name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: AI Solutions Builder | Agent Architecture, Prompt Engineering & Enterprise Delivery
summary: AI solutions builder with 15+ years delivering software implementations to business customers, and hands-on experience designing agent-based architectures, prompt engineering, and evaluation frameworks that run in production. As founder of Solenzo, I build the autonomous AI systems that drive real client outcomes, then own delivery end-to-end for a portfolio of accounts. New to regulated reporting and compliance domains specifically, but comfortable working at the frontier of what AI can reliably do and turning it into something repeatable.

Design self-improving loops and evaluation frameworks to monitor agent outputs and continuously optimize performance.
Architected and deployed a complete AI-driven automation system, 20+ workflows spanning lead capture, qualification, booking, and post-sale nurture, running in production for a portfolio of clients.
